title: ISO 10771-1:2015 — Hydraulic fluid power — Fatigue pressure testing of metal pressure-containing envelopes — Part 1: Test method
locator: Official abstract and scope: fatigue test method for metallic pressure-containing envelopes under sustained steady cyclic internal pressure loads; test pressure is determined by the user.
notes: The scope excludes piping as defined in ISO 4413, including connectors, hoses, tubing and pipes. This is a component pressure-envelope fatigue method, not an every-unit production proof/leak test and not a hose assembly test.
